contract.split_rule: For each disease independently shuffle sorted donors with seeded RNG; cyclic assignment starting at seeded offset; no outcomes; invalid partitions not replaced.
contract.loo_models: Complete frozen ladder and original fixed-embedding shortcut controls, plus strict training-side cross-fit residual; original fold assignments retained after diagnostic deletion.
contract.moderate_leverage: Not extreme/high and absolute delta influence at or above donor median.
contract.paired_bad_threshold: Each model donor MAE above its target/stratum donor 75th percentile.
contract.paired_much_better: M4 MAE at least 25 percent lower than M2 MAE.
contract.low_variance: Donor target variance at or below target/stratum 10th percentile.
contract.mahalanobis: LedoitWolf covariance of standardized training regions (region-equal covariance); train-only centroid and covariance. Ridge scaling remains unchanged.
contract.nearest_neighbor: Euclidean standardized distance to nearest other-donor training region; train reference also nearest other-donor training region.
contract.support_cloud: Nearest-neighbor cloud distance; convex hull infeasible in 32/33 dimensions.
contract.unsupported_donor: At least 10 percent regions beyond training Mahalanobis 99th percentile.
contract.strong_support_association: Donor Spearman rho >=0.5 and nominal p<0.05 (diagnostic).
contract.extrapolation_driven: Strong association; >=50 percent of positive paired SSE gain in unsupported donors; at least one unsupported donor LOO reduces delta >=50 percent relative to full.
contract.donor_leverage_driven: One or two donors flip sign/qualitative interpretation, either repeated delta or residual sign stability <0.80, without extrapolation criteria.
contract.stable_null: Both repeated 5-95 percent intervals within [-0.02,0.02], both medians abs<=0.01, full 95 percent bootstrap intervals within [-0.05,0.05], maximum absolute LOO delta/residual influence <=0.02.
contract.qualitative_interpretation: Pair of delta/residual CI direction (positive/negative/spans zero) and respective BH<0.05 classifications; FDR family three targets within diagnostic stratum, original primary BH only disease-adjusted.
contract.stable_signal: Delta/residual sign stability >=0.80 in POOLED, no disease-adjusted single-donor interpretation flip, original POOLED delta not <5 or >95 percentile, no extrapolation criteria; external authorization additionally requires positive median delta and positive median residual.
contract.verdict_priority: All positive stable targets: PASS; subset positive stable: SELECTIVE; else extrapolation, donor leverage, stable null majority, then fold instability. NO_GO only simultaneous delta/residual sign stability <0.65, leverage, non-extrapolation and broad repeat interval crossing zero.

figure_contract.claim: Distinguish donor influence, support mismatch and partition variability without changing the primary estimand.
